title: Hyperledger Iroha3
summary: Hyperledger Iroha 3 is the next-generation version of the Iroha framework, featuring enhanced performance, WASM smart contracts, and improved developer tooling. SORA v3 architecture draws from Iroha 3 innovations for enterprise-grade blockchain infrastructure.
